title: Build parser infrastructure
description: The parser imports lexer and AST types, then provides token-level navigation helpers.

steps.description: The module imports lexer token names, AST nodes, and Optional.
ParseError includes a source line. Parser stores its token list and current position.
_peek returns the current token. _advance returns it and moves past it unless it is EOF.
_expect verifies the current token kind and raises ParseError if it differs.
_match advances only when the current token matches one of the requested kinds.
